title: AI Meta Data Creator
short: Turn an article, or a CSV of pages, into three title tags, three meta descriptions and an H2/H3 outline each, with character counts so you can see what fits.
cost: Paid OpenAI usage on your own key: well under a cent per article on GPT-6 Luna, roughly 3 to 6 cents on GPT-5.6 Sol
inputs: Pasted article text and a target keyword, or a CSV with URL, Title and Content columns
outputs: Editable titles, meta descriptions and outlines to copy, and seo-metadata-generated.csv
how: Paste your OpenAI API key and pick a model. The key stays in this browser tab and goes only to OpenAI.
For one page, paste the article text and enter the target keyword.
For many pages, upload a CSV with URL, Title and Content columns and check the preview.
Add the audience and content goal if you know them, then generate.
Check the character counts, edit the wording, then copy or export.
note: The model cannot search the web, so the competitor analysis is its guess at what ranks, not a live SERP. Check any gap it names against a real search before you act on it.
